title: Aspose CLI operation outcome
description: The result of one operation in an edit batch, reported in input order.

id.description: Correlation id from the input batch.

index.description: Zero-based position in the input batch.

itemsAffected.description: Number of items the operation changed.

targets.description: Addresses the operation changed; a failed operation lists the targets it attempted.

error.description: Present only when status is failed, under --best-effort.

details.description: Structured context, the same object the error envelope would carry; for a not-found code it follows common/not-found-details.
